To the best of your ability, recreate the following plots from the penguins dataset. Focus your efforts on getting the content correct. If you have time at the end, as a bonus, you can try to match the styling as closely as you can.

Some of the tools you will need to use to recreate these plots you have not learned in class yet. That is on purpose. Part of this assignment is finding the information yourself. This can be from a Google search, in drop-in tutoring, or in office hours. Part of the struggle with figuring out new coding syntax is finding the words you need to even do the search.

Use AI at your own discretion (I would recommend not at all) and be sure to cite any AI use at the end of your homework.
